newsitem.title: UK: Full text of Guinness, GrandMet announcement.
newsitem.headline: Full text of Guinness, GrandMet announcement.

text.p: The following is the full text of the announcement issued on Tuesday by GrandMet and Guinness Plc on the proposals made by LVMH :
"In light of press speculation, GrandMet and Guinness confirm that their respective Chairmen met Mr. Bernard Arnault, Chairman of LVMH, at his request last Wednesday at Northolt, London.

"At that meeting, Mr. Arnault outlined a new proposal. This differed substantially from the proposal he outlined at their earlier meeting in Paris, in that it did not involve the wholesale demerger of the companies' non-spirits and wine activities but contemplated the break-up of Moet Hennessy with the champagne business becoming wholly owned by LVMH and the cognac business being acquired for shares in UDV.

"A further meeting between executives of all three companies took place in London today to clarify the new Northolt proposals. While there were elements of the new outline proposals which would not be in the best interests of Grand Met's and Guinness' shareholders in the form proposed, GrandMet and Guinness will assess in full the commercial and financial logic of this new proposal when it is detailed in writing.
"Although the new Northolt proposals build on the proposed GMG Brands merger, it is too early to establish whether any agreement can be reached.

"Any proposal, be it the Paris proposal or the Northolt proposal or some new proposal, will be judged both against the benchmark of the value created for shareholders by the GMG Brands merger and that such value is fairly distributed amongst all the shareholders involved."
